name: Seychelles National Botanical Gardens
subtitle: A botanical garden in Victoria that began as a plant-testing 'station' in 1901.

facts.label: Origin
facts.value: Began in 1901 as a botanic station under Paul Evenor Rivaltz Dupont

facts.label: Transformation
facts.value: Became the Botanical Garden mid-20th century

parts.text: A botanical garden in Victoria that began as a plant-testing 'station' in 1901. It became a public botanical garden in the mid-20th century.
